action_1.instructions: The user spoke a voice command to winfer, a terminal app for coding agents. Which app command does the transcript ask for first? The transcript may contain speech-recognition errors.

criteria.spawn_panes: Open new terminal panes running agents like claude, codex, agy, grok or a shell.
criteria.close_pane: Close an existing pane and stop whatever is running inside it.
criteria.focus_pane: Move keyboard focus to a specific existing pane.
criteria.zoom_pane: Maximize one pane to fill the window, or un-zoom it.
criteria.resize_pane: Make a pane bigger or smaller relative to its neighbours.
criteria.swap_panes: Swap the positions of two panes in the layout.
criteria.equalize_panes: Make all panes the same size.
criteria.set_layout: Change the pane arrangement, e.g. grid, columns, rows or stack.
criteria.send_to_pane: Type a message or instruction into one agent pane, e.g. tell claude to do something.
criteria.broadcast: Send the same message or instruction to every agent pane at once.
criteria.approve_agent: Approve or accept a pending permission request from an agent.
criteria.interrupt_agent: Stop or cancel what an agent is currently doing, without closing its pane.
criteria.open_url: Open a specific website, URL or localhost port in the built-in browser.
criteria.browser_new_tab: Open a new empty browser tab.
criteria.browser_switch_tab: Switch to another already-open browser tab.
criteria.browser_back: Go back to the previous page in the browser.
criteria.browser_forward: Go forward to the next page in the browser.
criteria.browser_reload: Reload or refresh the current browser page.
criteria.set_device: Change the microphone or audio input/output device.
criteria.switch_workspace: Switch to a different existing workspace or project.
criteria.toggle_browser: Show or hide the built-in browser panel.
criteria.load_recipe: Load a saved recipe, a preset set of panes and layout.
criteria.show_shortcuts: Show the list of keyboard shortcuts and voice commands.
criteria.repeat_last: Repeat the previous voice command again.
criteria.none: Not a command for the app: chatter, noise, unclear or unrelated speech.

target_pane.instructions: Which existing pane does the command refer to? 'it' or 'this' means the focused pane.
